other.label: CBO cost estimate: S. 2918, REPO for Ukrainians Implementation Act of 2025

summary: The REPO Implementation Act of 2025 amends existing law regarding the handling and use of seized Russian sovereign assets. It adds provisions for transferring non-confiscated Russian sovereign state assets into an interest-bearing account called the Ukraine Support Fund, mandates the investment of these funds in U.S. obligations, requires quarterly payouts to benefit Ukraine, directs diplomatic engagement with foreign countries regarding Russian assets located abroad, and requires specific reports on these assets.

affected_groups.effect: Receives quarterly financial assistance distributions of at least $250 million from the Ukraine Support Fund while funds remain.
Assumed new duties to transfer funds, invest monies in U.S. obligations, make quarterly disbursements, conduct diplomatic outreach, and submit detailed reports to Congress.
affected_groups.group: U.S. Federal Government Officials (President, Secretary of the Treasury, Secretary of State)

key_provisions: Allows the President to transfer Russian aggressor state sovereign assets into the Ukraine Support Fund without confiscating them, placing them into an interest-bearing account.
Requires the Secretary of the Treasury to invest unwithdrawn portions of the account in U.S. interest-bearing obligations and credit interest and proceeds back to the account.
Authorizes the Secretary of State to obligate and expend at least $250 million from the Fund every 90 days to provide assistance to Ukraine while funds remain.
Requires the President to submit reports to congressional committees within 90 and 270 days detailing Russian sovereign assets located in covered and non-covered foreign countries.

Encourages diplomatic efforts by the Secretary of State and Secretary of the Treasury to persuade covered countries to repurpose at least 5 percent of the Russian sovereign assets in their countries for Ukraine quarterly.
missing_information: The total dollar value or exact amount of Russian sovereign assets that will be successfully transferred or invested.
The specific operational criteria or guidelines the President will use to select which assets are transferred versus confiscated.
The exact financial return rates on the U.S. obligations in which the funds are invested.
summary_detail.plain_summary: The REPO Implementation Act of 2025 amends existing law regarding the handling and use of seized Russian sovereign assets. It adds provisions for transferring non-confiscated Russian sovereign state assets into an interest-bearing account called the Ukraine Support Fund, mandates the investment of these funds in U.S. obligations, requires quarterly payouts to benefit Ukraine, directs diplomatic engagement with foreign countries regarding Russian assets located abroad, and requires specific reports on these assets.
summary_detail.significance: This legislation alters the mechanisms for managing and distributing funds derived from Russian sovereign assets to support Ukraine. It establishes specific investment rules and a predictable quarterly disbursement schedule, while expanding reporting requirements and diplomatic engagement concerning Russian assets held globally.
